item: A1 -- token-type geometry discovery (unsupervised ring recovery over token types)

declared_rules.representation: per token type t: mean over ALL cache rows whose tokens.i32 == t of the sparse SAE code vector, then projected mean_code @ W_dec -> 1152-d. b_dec is NOT added (the task text says 'W_dec projection'); it is a constant offset that PCA removes exactly and that cancels exactly in the centred cosine arm.
declared_rules.extended_pool_use: floor-30 pool is used ONLY for the supervised colour sensitivity arm and its matched background; it never enters discovery, clustering or the main background
declared_rules.accumulator_dtype: float64, divided by count, cast to float32 before the W_dec matmul

clustering_arms.centred_leiden: cosine on pool-mean-centred means; edges where cos >= tau, weights = cos; Leiden RBConfigurationVertexPartition, resolution 1.0, seed 0, n_iterations=-1. PRIMARY ARM (declared primary a priori: the pool-mean direction is common-mode and carries no type-distinguishing information)
clustering_arms.raw_leiden: identical but cosine on the uncentred means. SECONDARY ARM
clustering_arms.refined: declared refinement of each Leiden arm's selected partition: any cluster larger than 60 is re-partitioned by Leiden on its induced subgraph at resolutions [2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64] in turn, taking the first partition whose max sub-cluster size <= 60; if none achieves it, the last resolution's partition is used and only sub-clusters in the screening band are kept. Clusters already in the band pass through unchanged. Fully label-blind
clustering_arms.hdbscan: HDBSCAN on L2-normalised pool-mean-centred means, metric euclidean, min_cluster_size 5, min_samples 5, cluster_selection_method eom. SECONDARY ARM

declared_rules.threshold_selection_rule: sweep the whole declared grid and record it. A threshold is VALID iff its graph is within the edge budget AND the number of clusters of size >= 5 lies in [10, 300] AND the largest cluster holds <= 10% of the pool. Select the SMALLEST valid threshold. Fallback 1 if none is valid: the smallest threshold whose largest cluster holds <= 10% of the pool. Fallback 2: the largest threshold in the grid.
declared_rules.screening: every cluster with 5 <= size <= 60: PCA top-2 of the member means (fits.pca_2d), Kasa circle fit, fits.circularity -> gap_ratio, max_gap_deg, radius_ratio; p_closed = uniform-angle gap null at 20000 permutations (identical to scripts/13_rerun_gate.gap_pvalue, with the null draws cached per (k, n_perm, seed) -- the same numbers, computed once)
declared_rules.background: for every cluster size represented, 500 random same-size token-type subsets drawn WITHOUT replacement from the identical >= 100-count pool, through the identical screening at 2000 permutations. p_bg for an observed cluster = (1 + #{background draws with max_gap_deg <= observed}) / (1 + n_draws), computed on max_gap_deg rather than p_closed so the two permutation counts never have to be reconciled (at fixed k the gap p-value is monotone in the gap). A secondary occurrence-count-decile-matched background is drawn for flagged and label-bearing clusters only.
declared_rules.flag_rule: FLAGGED iff p_closed < 0.05 AND p_bg <= 0.05. BH-FDR over p_closed within (layer, arm) and globally is reported alongside but does not change the flag.
declared_rules.label_stage: runs only after every partition and every screening number is frozen. A label counts as PRESENT in a cluster if any of its qualifying token-type variants is a member; when several variants are present the highest-cache-count variant is the one scored. A cluster is label-scored if it is flagged, or if it holds >= ceil(2/3 * full_k) labels of a set -- the latter at ANY size, including clusters far larger than the screening band, which is how the negative space gets reported.
declared_rules.ordering: fits.cyclic_order_score at 20000 permutations, max over the 2*full_k rotation/reflection symmetries, with the survivors' TRUE cycle positions. Reported from the cluster-level PCA angles (primary) and from a PCA of the label members alone (secondary). Both SVD sign conventions are reported: the max-over-symmetries rho is reflection-invariant by construction, so the rotation-only rho is reported per sign convention as the quantity that is not. A shuffled-labels control of 1000 draws is reported separately from the internal permutation null.
declared_rules.ordering_is_not_evidence: ESTABLISHED IN THIS PROJECT AND CARRIED FORWARD: the ordering tier accepts random subsets at ~0.16 and an ordinal control out-orders months at every layer. Ordering alone is never evidence here. Closure against the matched background is the discriminating tier.

label_sets.numbers_one_to_ten: ['one', 'two', 'three', 'four', 'five', 'six', 'seven', 'eight', 'nine', 'ten'], ORDINAL CONTROL -- must not close. Truncated at ten because ' eleven' (28) and ' twelve' (44) fall below the count floor; the truncation is declared, not chosen after seeing a result
label_sets.digits_0_9: 0-9, scored on the mod-10 cycle. CONFOUND DECLARED IN ADVANCE: at token-type level the token identity IS the value, so a digit ring is a statement about token-type geometry and can never be read as a base-10 helix or a depth claim

declared_rules.calibration_disclosure: Before the freeze, a LABEL-BLIND probe at layer 0 measured the centred and raw cosine percentiles, the edge count per candidate threshold, and the Leiden size profile, to set the two grids and the edge budget so that a valid threshold exists. No label set, no token string and no cluster content was inspected. Nothing else was calibrated.
declared_rules.layers_0_4_note: Layers 0-4 are embedding-adjacent: a hit there validates the pipeline and says the geometry is present near the input, NOT that it is computed at depth.
declared_rules.context_averaging_note: A per-token-type mean over all corpus occurrences is a context-AVERAGED object, closer to a static embedding than to a computed feature. A ring here is a statement about the model's average representation of those token types, and is weaker than a claim about a ring the model uses in context.

layers.depth_note: layer >= 5: not embedding-adjacent, but the representation is still a context-averaged token-type mean

summary.supervised_note: best_supervised_label_subset_closure re-runs PCA on the label token types alone. It selects them by name, so it is the supervised anchor, not a discovery result. Read it together with colocation_best, which IS label-blind.

caveats: DECLARED EXPLORATORY. Not pre-registered. Nothing here can change a gate verdict.

The representation is a CONTEXT-AVERAGED token-type mean over every corpus occurrence. It is closer to a static embedding than to a computed feature, so a ring here is a claim about the model's average representation of those token types, not about a structure the model manipulates in context.
Layers 0-4 are embedding-adjacent. A hit at those layers validates the pipeline and locates geometry near the input; it is not a depth claim.

ORDERING IS NEVER EVIDENCE HERE. This project measured the ordering tier accepting random subsets at ~0.16 with an ordinal control out-ordering months at every layer. Closure against the matched same-size background is the tier that discriminates, and the per-size background acceptance rate is reported next to every flag so the reader can see the false-acceptance floor at that k.

The flag rule is uncorrected across the whole scan by design (it is the declared rule); bh_pass_within_layer_arm and expected_false_flags_at_alpha_05 are reported so a flag count can be read against its own multiplicity.

The colour arm is not a discovery result: at the frozen count floor two of the six hue terms do not exist in the pool, so colours are UNTESTABLE by discovery here, and the floor-30 arm that does score them is supervised (the six token types are chosen by name) and matched only against a floor-30 random background.

digits_0_9 carries the confound declared before the run: at token-type level the token identity IS the value, so any digit structure is token-type geometry and must not be read as a base-10 helix or as evidence about depth.
numbers_one_to_ten is an ordinal control and is truncated at ten by the count floor; it must fail closure, and a run in which it closes is invalid rather than interesting.

The refinement arm splits oversized clusters label-blind, but it is an extra selection surface: more candidate clusters means more chances to flag one, which is why the matched background and the expected-false-flag count are reported per arm rather than pooled.

The cosine grids and the edge budget were calibrated on a label-blind layer-0 density probe before the freeze; this is disclosed rather than hidden, and no label or cluster content was inspected in that probe.
